what: Stage A phase 2 PRE-LAUNCH solve-mesh sanity: one forward + one gradient on the REAL 5600-in-part-node square case at the fixed 0.40x drive, before detaching the heavy solve. Confirms the melt-onset envelope argmin is INTERIOR (not step 0, not the horizon) and the first gradient is finite and nonzero, so the detached run cannot burn its budget on a bit-identical J (run_tamper NonFiniteGradientError lesson).
note: per-eval cost 355 s (forward + checkpointed gradient) sets the ETA: budget 12 ~= 71 min, budget 40 ~= 4 h.
